title: Declarative binding
description: A tier-1 adapter: a YAML document the runner's generic HTTP engine interprets deterministically (SPEC.md §10a, ADR-022). Validate after decoding the YAML to JSON. Deliberately ~8 primitives; the moment a binding needs logic it graduates to a process adapter — no expression language may ever grow in here. Templating: '{{config.x}}', '{{record.field}}', '{{variables.name}}', '{{session}}'. A leaf that is exactly one placeholder substitutes the typed value; placeholders may list alternatives separated by '|' (first non-empty wins); leaves resolving to empty/null are omitted from the request (omitempty). In a deliver body, an object may carry the key '$variables': true — the resolved variables: mapping (minus any variable referenced individually elsewhere in the body) is spliced into that object. The engine pre-fills config defaults declared in config_schema.

id.description: Adapter id, e.g. 'attio/assert'. Named by the contract owner (ADR-026). The id's vendor prefix is the COST provider name.

role.description: source: pagination + cursor/STATE, config 'limit' caps emitted records; enrich: per-record request; deliver: idempotency + dry-run receipts.

needs.description: Same manifest surface as process adapters (SPEC.md §6): a JSON Schema, 'dynamic', or the dynamic-with-floor object form.

provides.description: Same manifest surface as process adapters (SPEC.md §6).

name.description: Header or query-param name; unused for basic/bearer.

env.description: Env var holding the credential (resolved per SPEC.md §6 credentials rules).

prefix.description: Optional literal prefix for the value, e.g. 'Bearer '.

request.description: Templating draws only from step config, the record's canonical fields, resolved variables, and the session id — no expressions, no computation.

query.description: Query-param templates; empty resolutions are omitted.

body.description: Body template: a JSON shape whose string leaves are templates. Empty resolutions are omitted. '$variables': true in an object splices the resolved variables map.

param.description: Request param carrying the page number / cursor / offset.

cursor_path.description: Dotted path to the next cursor in the response (cursor strategy).

page_size.description: Records per page: an integer or a template (e.g. '{{config.per_page}}').

size_param.description: Request param carrying the page size.

empty_records.description: Stop when a page yields zero records (engine default: always on).

short_page.description: Stop when a page yields fewer records than page_size.

total_pages_path.description: Dotted path to a total-page count; alternatives via '|'.

records.description: Dotted path to the record array (or single record) in the response; a list means first non-empty wins.

fields.description: canonical (or vendor-namespaced) field name -> extraction rule.

transform.description: A registry normalization rule id (SPEC.md §4a) — or 'linkedin', the engine-owned §4 classify-and-route rule that stores a LinkedIn-URL-shaped value under the field matching its shape. Never arbitrary logic.

absent.description: Sentinel values the vendor uses to mean 'no value' (e.g. a locked-email placeholder, 0 for an unknown count); matched exactly, treated as absent.

skip_if_input.description: Omit this output field when the projected input already carried a non-empty value for it (e.g. only emit a resolved public linkedin_url when the record arrived without one).

errors.description: HTTP status (or status class like '4xx') -> verdict mapping; statuses the map does not name follow the engine's default classification (SPEC.md §8 exit-code classes).

idempotency.description: Which party guarantees delivery dedupe: the vendor's own semantics (native, e.g. an assert/upsert endpoint) or the runner's deliveries table (ledger). Required for role: deliver.

unit_path.description: Dotted path to a units-consumed count in the response (per: unit).

session.description: Optional pagination-consistency session: a UUID minted per run and passed through on every request.
